notes: Pitch-stage descriptions with company names stripped. 'source' and 'outcome_note' are for the team only and are never sent to a model. Models may still recognise famous cases, so this is a sanity check, not proof.

cases.outcome_note: Shut down 2017 after it emerged the packs could be squeezed by hand.

canvas.target_user: Health-conscious, affluent households who want fresh cold-pressed juice at home every day
canvas.problem: Fresh cold-pressed juice is expensive at juice bars, and home juicers are slow, messy and hard to clean
canvas.solution: A Wi-Fi connected countertop press that squeezes single-serve sealed packs of pre-chopped fruit and vegetables delivered weekly; the machine scans each pack and blocks expired ones
canvas.price: $699 for the press plus $5-8 per pack on a weekly subscription
canvas.riskiest_belief: Customers will pay a premium for a dedicated machine and proprietary packs instead of buying bottled juice
canvas.market: US premium home appliances and the cold-pressed juice market

cases.outcome_note: Launched April 2020, shut down six months later.

canvas.target_user: Adults aged 18-44 who watch video on their phones in short gaps during the day
canvas.problem: Premium TV and film content is made for long sessions on big screens, not for 5-10 minute mobile moments
canvas.solution: A mobile-only streaming app with Hollywood-produced shows cut into chapters under 10 minutes, with a patented format that reframes between portrait and landscape
canvas.price: $4.99 per month with ads, $7.99 per month ad-free
canvas.riskiest_belief: People will pay for short premium mobile video even though free short video is everywhere

cases.outcome_note: Bankrupt in 2001 after heavy spending on warehouses.

canvas.target_user: Busy urban and suburban households who dislike weekly grocery trips
canvas.problem: Grocery shopping takes hours every week and stores are crowded
canvas.solution: Order groceries online and get delivery in a 30-minute window you choose; we build our own large automated warehouses and our own delivery fleet in each city
canvas.price: Supermarket prices, free delivery on orders over $50
canvas.riskiest_belief: Enough households in each city will order often enough to fill a very expensive automated warehouse quickly
canvas.market: US grocery retail, rolling out to 26 cities

cases.outcome_note: Liquidated in 2000, about nine months after its IPO.

canvas.target_user: Pet owners who buy food and supplies every month
canvas.problem: Carrying heavy bags of pet food home from the store is a chore and local pet stores have limited range
canvas.solution: An online pet supply store delivering food, toys and accessories to the door, backed by a national TV advertising campaign
canvas.price: Prices at or below the big pet store chains, with low shipping charges
canvas.riskiest_belief: We can ship heavy, low-margin products profitably once we reach scale

cases.outcome_note: Shut down in 2015 amid low customer retention and worker classification lawsuits.

canvas.target_user: Busy urban professionals who want a clean home without hiring a regular cleaner
canvas.problem: Booking a trusted house cleaner is slow, prices are opaque and quality varies
canvas.solution: Book a vetted independent cleaner online in 60 seconds, pay by card, with heavy first-clean discounts to grow fast across many cities
canvas.price: First clean $19-29 with a promo, then about $25 per hour
canvas.riskiest_belief: Customers will keep booking through the platform after the first discounted clean instead of hiring the cleaner directly
canvas.market: US and international home cleaning services

cases.outcome_note: Collapsed 2016-2018; the technology did not work as claimed.

canvas.target_user: Patients who need routine blood tests, and the pharmacies and clinics that serve them
canvas.problem: Blood tests need a full needle draw, take days and are expensive
canvas.solution: A compact device that runs hundreds of lab tests from a few drops of blood from a finger prick, with results in hours, placed inside retail pharmacies
canvas.price: Published prices up to 90% below Medicare reimbursement rates
canvas.riskiest_belief: Our device gives lab-grade accuracy on hundreds of tests from a finger-prick sample

canvas.target_user: Travellers on a budget, and people with a spare room or couch who want extra income
canvas.problem: Hotels sell out and are expensive during big events and conferences, while many homes have unused space
canvas.solution: A website where hosts list a spare room, couch or air mattress and guests book and pay online, with profiles and reviews for trust
canvas.price: Free to list; we take a small commission on each booking
canvas.riskiest_belief: Strangers will trust each other enough to stay in each other's homes

canvas.target_user: People who work across several computers and keep emailing files to themselves or carrying USB drives
canvas.problem: Keeping files in sync between computers is painful and files get lost or overwritten
canvas.solution: A folder on every computer that syncs automatically to the cloud and all your other devices, with version history
canvas.price: Free up to 2 GB, paid plans around $10 per month for more space
canvas.riskiest_belief: Enough free users will upgrade, and big tech companies will not make this a free built-in feature first
canvas.market: Consumer and small business file storage and sync

canvas.target_user: Software developers at startups who need to accept card payments online
canvas.problem: Getting a merchant account and payment gateway takes weeks of paperwork and poor, old-fashioned APIs
canvas.solution: A developer-first payments API: add a few lines of code and start charging cards the same day, with simple docs and instant sign-up
canvas.price: 2.9% + 30 cents per successful charge, no setup or monthly fees
canvas.riskiest_belief: We can handle fraud and compliance well enough while making onboarding instant

canvas.target_user: Suburban families and students who want food from local restaurants that do not deliver
canvas.problem: Most good local restaurants have no delivery, especially outside big city centres
canvas.solution: An app to order from any local restaurant, fulfilled by independent drivers we dispatch, starting in suburbs that big players ignore
canvas.price: Delivery fee of about $5-7 per order plus a commission from restaurants
canvas.riskiest_belief: Order volume per area will be high enough to cover driver costs

canvas.target_user: Dog and cat owners who buy the same food every month
canvas.problem: Heavy pet food is a pain to carry home and running out is stressful
canvas.solution: An online pet store with fast shipping, automatic repeat deliveries and an unusually personal 24/7 customer service team
canvas.price: Competitive with big pet stores, free shipping above about $49
canvas.riskiest_belief: Repeat autoship customers will stay long enough to pay back the cost of shipping heavy goods

canvas.target_user: Busy urban households who want groceries from the stores they already like
canvas.problem: Grocery shopping takes time every week and existing online grocers have limited choice
canvas.solution: An app where independent shoppers pick your order at your existing local supermarket and deliver within an hour; we own no warehouses or inventory
canvas.price: Delivery fee from $3.99, plus a markup on some items
canvas.riskiest_belief: Shoppers can pick orders fast and accurately enough to make each delivery profitable

canvas.problem: They do not have enough ice
canvas.solution: Daily drone delivery of bagged ice from Karachi to Antarctica

canvas.problem: Pet rocks may get sick and need treatment
canvas.solution: Monthly health insurance for pet rocks, with claims settled by an AI that checks whether the rock looks unwell
canvas.riskiest_belief: Rock owners worry about rock illness

canvas.solution: A smartphone app that sends a push notification every 4 seconds reminding you to inhale and exhale; breathing is locked unless you subscribe
canvas.riskiest_belief: People will pay to be reminded to breathe

canvas.problem: Houseplants are lonely and have no social network
canvas.solution: A social media platform where plants post updates and pay a subscription from their own bank accounts
canvas.price: $12 per plant per month, paid by the plant
